title: Show HN: Engrim – A universal, local-first SQLite memory engine for AI CLIs
summary: Engrim is a universal, local-first memory engine built on SQLite that enables AI command-line interfaces to maintain persistent context and state across conversations without relying on cloud services.
problem_solved: Enables AI CLI tools to maintain persistent memory and context locally, eliminating the need for cloud-based memory services while preserving user privacy.
why_valuable: Provides a privacy-preserving, open-source solution for AI context management that keeps all data on the user's machine while remaining framework-agnostic.
